node: Student-loan servicing, education payments, borrower communication, and compliance systems
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the student-loan servicing and education-payments node finds a narrow but investable US-listed universe. The strongest reference anchor is Nelnet, whose public segment disclosure directly maps to Loan Servicing and Systems plus Education Technology Services and Payments. The underfollowed discovery lane includes Maximus as a government-services contractor with federal student-loan servicing exposure through Aidvantage, Flywire as an education payment-processing and tuition-flow platform, and SLM as a private education-loan originator/servicer where servicing infrastructure is relevant but credit risk dominates the public-market story. This pass intentionally avoids consumer-facing online education brands and focuses on regulated workflow, payments, borrower communications, servicing scale, and compliance chokepoints.
